items.raw_excerpt: At a time when anti-immigration protests are sweeping the country, Co Galway is proving there is another way to do things
items.summary_en: In County Galway, one small town is taking a different path on immigration. While anti-immigration protests grow across Ireland, this community chooses to welcome people seeking protection.

items.raw_excerpt: A central Queensland mother and daughter who debuted for the same rugby league club this season have their sight set on the grand final.
items.summary_en: A mother and daughter from central Queensland are playing for the same rugby league club this season. Both debuted together and now aim for the grand final.
